_comment: The files a new project needs to generate, rig, animate and ragdoll humanoid characters the way this repository does. Copy with the blender-csg-levels skill's scripts/copy_kit.py; --check proves every path still exists here.

files.why: fetches the pinned packs into a cache outside the repository, verifies SHA-256, unpacks, and answers which pack a file belongs to (the allowlist)
the pins: MPFB2, the MakeHuman CC0 system assets, the Universal Animation Library, with URLs, hashes, sizes and licences
the body build: table row to MPFB human, height fit, proxy, decimation, rigid gear with poke-through tests, atlases, one skinned glb, budget check, --verify
the body table's schema, defaults and cross-checks; plain Python
the typed-field validator the tables share (unknown keys are errors)
the reference table: 36 bodies, palette, 30 gear pieces, stress pose
paints the skin roughness map (T-zone, cheeks, body) on MakeHuman's UV layout
its output, which the body build reads
keys extra clips on UAL's rig from a table: aims, rotations, two-bone IK feet, seamless sine loops
the Surrender and Cower clips
EEVEE studio for the lineup renders
lineup, faction and stress-pose stills from the committed glbs
writes the bone maps and each glb's retarget import options (Godot's BoneMapper is editor-only)
one inherited scene per body: ragdoll capsules and joints, AnimationPlayer with the shared libraries, weapon grip and accessory mounts
skin (subsurface) and outfit materials per body, mapped onto the glb's materials at import
guards the retarget option keys a second setup run once broke
the committed bone maps: MPFB game_engine and UAL Rigify DEF bones to SkeletonProfileHumanoid
state-to-clip map, cross-fade, accessory mounts, ragdoll capsules, masses and settle time
builds joints at rest, adds neighbour collision exceptions, settles then freezes
drops each body off a step and measures speed, joint gaps and rest
the ragdoll check's scene
this skill, so the next project's agent knows the pipeline

adapt: Rename the cache: fetch_character_tools.cache_dir() reads $UNDERCITY_DEPS and defaults to ~/.cache/undercity/deps.
The UAL pack is fetch: manual (its page serves a newer build now); copy a verified ual_standard.zip into <cache>/packs/ once, or re-pin a build you download and update the clip table's paths.
Replace npcs.json with your own table (start from the skill's templates/example_table.json); keep budget, palette and stress_pose.
render_npcs.py imports ROOT from blendkit.py (the level kit), which needs game/materials/materials.json: copy the level kit too, or define ROOT locally.
gen_npc_scenes.gd names Brushfire's physics layers (WORLD 1, DEBRIS 32), the RightHand grip clip and NpcRagdoll's path: set them to your project's.
NpcRagdoll.cs is in namespace Undercity.Client and floats bodies through LevelWater (the water-and-swimming change): change the namespace, and copy LevelWater or drop the buoyancy.
Godot: enable Jolt Physics (Project Settings, physics/3d/physics_engine). GodotPhysics3D exploded every ragdoll in the measurement.
